audit.whatIsWrong: All seven stages are scored Trundle, and five of them contradict the page's own whys[]. whys[2] 'pulling the trade back to even'; whys[3] 'Neither of you can force a clean kill'; whys[4] 'Level 6 is your spike'; whys[5] 'the one window where you outright beat his drain-tank pattern'; whys[6] 'the lane nets out even'.
audit.why: The packet chart matches all seven whys. Subjugate contributes nothing to a 1v1 Cho'Gath refuses to take, and Feast's true damage is the single stat in the matchup that Subjugate cannot steal and drain-tank resistances cannot reduce — level 6 and first item are Cho'Gath's.
audit.corrected: Level 3 Skill (5/10), Levels 4-5 Skill (5/10), Level 6 Cho'Gath (6/10), First item Cho'Gath (6/10), 2+ items Skill (5/10). Proposed as one atomic chart group across both layers; Levels 1 and 2 stay Trundle.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) FABRICATED, four occurrences: 'Chomp (Q) steals your attack damage and heals him'. Riot's Chomp text is 'dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage' — no healing whatsoever. Trundle's sustain is King's Tribute (P), which heals him when an enemy unit DIES near him, i.e. off minions, not off Cho'Gath. That mislocation hides the actual counterplay: deny him minion deaths. (b) Frozen Domain is described only as move/attack speed — it also increases his healing from all sources, which is what makes King's Tribute dangerous inside it. (c) Pillar of Ice is called 'his Pillar (E) escape' and a peel-slow. Riot: it 'becomes impassable terrain'. Against a Cho'Gath with no dash that is a wall across your exit, not a slow. (d) Chomp is an auto-attack reset, which is the burst tell — never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot text — King's Tribute: 'When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.' Chomp: 3.5s flat, 300 range, autoReset flag. Frozen Domain: 18/17/16/15/14s, 750 range, 'gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.' Pillar of Ice: 21/19.5/18/16.5/15s, 1000 range, impassable terrain plus slow. Subjugate: 120/100/80s, 650 range, 'steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount stolen is doubled.'
audit.corrected: King's Tribute replaces the invented Chomp heal in spikes[0].text, whys[0], wants.foe[0], dontsFull[1] and report[5].t; Frozen Domain's healing amplification added to spikes[0].text; Pillar of Ice's impassable terrain added to dontsFull[2], breakdown.cooldowns and whys[5]; Subjugate's 120s and its doubling over 4 seconds added to dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four separate fields gate the trading plan on Chomp's cooldown — 'Bait Trundle's Chomp (Q), then land Rupture on its cooldown', 'Bait his Chomp, combo on its cooldown', 'your combo needs his Chomp on cooldown', 'Don't walk up to auto while his Q is up'. Chomp is 3.5 SECONDS. It is effectively never down.
audit.why: This is the same failure the mirror audits found on Sejuani (Permafrost, 1.5s) and Cho'Gath's own Rupture (6s flat) — a 'fight when X is down' line emitted without consulting the cooldown field. The cooldowns that can actually be played around here are Pillar of Ice at 21s and Frozen Domain at 18s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns repointed to Pillar of Ice's 21s and states Chomp's 3.5s explicitly so the reader stops waiting for it; phases[5].why and whys[5] repointed to Subjugate's 120s and Pillar's 21s.

audit.why: 'Anti-heal his sustain' is the right headline and it is already a dosFull entry — King's Tribute plus Frozen Domain's healing amplification make Grievous Wounds core, not situational.

notes:
The 'Chomp heals him' claim appears in five places on this page; I corrected four (spikes[0].text, whys[0], wants.foe[0], and the dontsFull entry that assumed it). The fifth is inside the 'early' paragraph ('his Chomp (Q) bites off a chunk of your attack damage and heals him') — left this pass to hold the edit count down, and it should be picked up next run.

UNVERIFIED, left as written: the page states Feral Scream is a 2-second silence in three places. champ-data/_kits/chogath.json gives Feral Scream's cooldown (11/10.5/10/9.5/9), cost and 300 range but no duration, so I neither propagated nor contradicted the 2s figure — every line I rewrote uses the cooldown instead.

Unlike Sion's Unstoppable Onslaught, Trundle's Pillar of Ice 'terrain' flag is NOT a misfire — Riot's own description says it becomes impassable terrain, so I used it. Worth noting for whoever is auditing the flag generator: the flag is right sometimes, which is why it cannot be trusted without reading the description.
